directive_events.owner_directive: Adapt the old draft into galgame dialogue beats and land the level's own prerequisites at bootstrap
directive_events.reason: plan

directive_events.owner_directive: 关卡4恢复回来然后继续做；这回先做关卡4（新的关卡5是介绍 ADR-054 miniapp 的关卡，后面再说）
directive_events.reason: Worktree was destroyed by the 2026-09-06 bulk cleanup; uncommitted level-4 work restored from the cleanup backup patch onto current origin/main

directive_events.owner_directive: 教程目的不是教用户怎么设置workflow、怎么连线。load the slides 那里先给用户写好一个基本的 workflow，然后让用户动手改；drag Load + Browse + 设置这些帮用户做好。废话太多，先自己砍一下简化，然后把教程 yaml 给我批注
directive_events.reason: Owner redirected level 4: it is not a wiring lesson; pre-build the workflow and trim the copy

directive_events.owner_directive: 数据现在看上去太假了。能不能搞个真的HE染色组织图，还有对应的空间转录组数据？
directive_events.reason: Owner: the synthetic dataset looks fake; replace it with real data

directive_events.owner_directive: 用B吧（10x Visium Human Breast Cancer Block A Section 1/2），2张就够了。新的剧情我重新设计。你先搞新数据
directive_events.reason: Owner chose the dataset; story to be redesigned by owner

directive_events.owner_directive: 那就6mb就行了（两张切片：H&E 1000px JPEG + 200 个基因的表达表）
directive_events.reason: Owner approved the shipped size of the real dataset

directive_events.owner_directive: 保留2000个基因，存csv吧，29MB可以接受
directive_events.reason: Owner widened the gene panel and chose CSV

directive_events.owner_directive: 开例外（给关卡4的数据目录开 check-added-large-files 例外）。先提交一个远端分支，我去另外一个电脑上继续开发
directive_events.reason: Owner approved a check-added-large-files exception for level 4's real dataset (two ~15 MB CSVs); push a remote branch to continue on another machine

directive_events.owner_directive: 重写教程4剧情以匹配真数据（两张H&E肿瘤切片+配对Visium空间表达，问题=癌组织vs其他组织的表达差异）。先落地owner批注的两处：summary 和第一步 two-instruments-one-question 的 say。
directive_events.reason: Real Visium+H&E assets replaced the fake data; storyline must be rewritten. Owner annotated the summary and the opening step; write those first.

directive_events.owner_directive: 换用候选1数据集：Wu et al. 2021 乳腺癌 Visium 图谱（Zenodo 4739739, CC-BY-4.0，含每 spot 病理标注 + annotated H&E）。取 4 例切片，便于设计后面的 pairing 和 branching 剧情。
directive_events.reason: Current 10x Block A assets carry no pathologist annotation; owner chose to replace them with an annotated public dataset so the storyline can use a real cancer-region mask.

directive_events.owner_directive: 选定 4 例：CID4535(ER+)、CID4290(ER+)、CID44971(TNBC)、CID4465(TNBC)。病理 Classification 标注做成 mask 图片（由 spot 级标签栅格化派生，需在 SOURCE.md 注明为派生物）。
directive_events.reason: Owner selected the four samples and chose rasterised mask images over a per-spot label column, so the tutorial can show a cancer-region mask on the H&E.

directive_events.owner_directive: mask 做成多类、按颜色区分（不是二值癌/非癌）。
directive_events.reason: Owner chose a multi-class colour mask over a binary cancer mask, so the mask asset must encode several pathology classes by colour.

directive_events.owner_directive: mask 保留 spot 点阵（不做形态学填充）；5 类归并方案通过：Invasive cancer / DCIS / Stroma / Lymphocytes / Normal，Uncertain+Artefact 丢弃。
directive_events.reason: Owner settled the two open mask-design questions so asset generation can start.

directive_events.owner_directive: 资产落地：把 4 例 Wu 2021 资产（he.jpg / mask.png / counts.csv）写入 assets/data，删除旧的合成数据与 10x Block A 数据，更新 SOURCE.md。
directive_events.reason: Owner approved the generated assets; land them and retire the superseded synthetic and 10x Block A data.

directive_events.owner_directive: 英式拼写一律改美式（analyse→analyze 等）。
directive_events.reason: Owner set the spelling convention for this tutorial's prose and code comments.

directive_events.owner_directive: 删掉开场之后的所有步骤（从 the-question 起到结尾），整条剧情随数据重写，接下来说到哪写到哪。
directive_events.reason: The new assets invalidate every downstream beat; owner scrapped them rather than patching, and will direct the rewrite beat by beat.

directive_events.owner_directive: 清理掉残留的旧剧情注释。结构：开场先引入 2 例，后面换亚型切 git branch 时再引入另外 2 例。
directive_events.reason: Owner set the sample-reveal structure and asked for the stale comments to go with the deleted beats.

directive_events.owner_directive: 开场用两例 ER（CID4535、CID4290）；两例 TNBC 留到切分支时引入。
directive_events.reason: Owner picked which subtype opens the level.

directive_events.owner_directive: 第一步 focus 到 Data，并加一句：项目里所有数据都能在 Data 卡片下看到。第二步：先给读者写好一个读数据的 workflow，再让读者看数据。
directive_events.reason: Owner directed the shape of the first two beats.

directive_events.owner_directive: core 没有读 jpg/png 成像素的能力，给这个 project 专门写一个 io block 读 jpg 和 png。
directive_events.reason: Core load_data only reaches jpg/png as opaque Artifacts, so the project needs its own pixel loader.

directive_events.owner_directive: 给这个 project 专门写一个 image previewer。
directive_events.reason: The shipped previewer renders grayscale micrographs; the Visium slides are RGB.

directive_events.owner_directive: 第一步的 focus 不要一上来就罩在 Data 上，等说到 'They are waiting under Data' 这句之后再出现。
directive_events.reason: Owner watched the step in the app and wants the Data ring to arrive with the line that names it.

directive_events.owner_directive: 不要 4 个 Load——SciStudio 支持批处理，用 Collection。
directive_events.reason: Four single-file Loads ignored the product's batch model; a multi-path Load emits a Collection and every downstream block runs once per item.

directive_events.owner_directive: read-them-in 第一拍改为：让我们先看一下数据长啥样。我帮你搭建了一个 workflow 读入数据。
directive_events.reason: Owner rewrote the beat; the shipped wording was too wordy.

directive_events.owner_directive: 把教程自己的 Image 类型改名为 HEImage。
directive_events.reason: The imaging package's entry-point Image type shadows the tutorial's drop-in one; a distinct name removes the collision.

directive_events.owner_directive: 修复 Load 报 'no load capability registered for HEImage'（loader block 没进 bootstrap）；mask 用 HEMask 类型。
directive_events.reason: The new loader block was never added to bootstrap, so no capability reached the project; and the mask needs a type of its own.

directive_events.owner_directive: loader 多路径缺陷派 implementer 单独开 PR 修；方案定为：默认铺开列表，除非 loader 显式声明自己吃列表。
directive_events.reason: The multi-path loader defect is core work outside this guided session; owner directed a separate implementer PR.

directive_events.owner_directive: 看数据这一步要带上 mask 一起。
directive_events.reason: Owner wants the mask present when the reader first looks at the data, not held back.

directive_events.owner_directive: mask 加颜色 legend；mask 显示时最好半透明叠加到 H&E 图上。
directive_events.reason: Owner asked for a colour key on the mask preview and a translucent overlay of the mask on its slide.

directive_events.owner_directive: 叠加配色定方案2：底图去色成灰度 + mask 用满饱和色；无彩色（Normal 灰）保持中性不饱和化。
directive_events.reason: Owner picked the overlay look from the rendered comparison.

directive_events.owner_directive: mask 本来就是我们造的假图——直接把叠加好的图当 mask 存成资产读进去，不要在 previewer/block 里现场合成。
directive_events.reason: The mask is an asset we author, so the overlay belongs in the file rather than in a render-time join the previewer cannot make.

directive_events.owner_directive: 先清理：去掉过时描述（mask 背景黑、每像素颜色即区域）、残留英式拼写、旧合成数据的 4 个 block，测试改到当前剧情。合成 mask PNG 的 legend 在预览里完全糊掉，要修。
directive_events.reason: Owner asked to clear the loose ends found on resume, and reported the baked-in mask legend is unreadable

directive_events.owner_directive: core 预览降采样违反 #1886 忠实显示原则——写短 prompt 转给 ADR-054 重构 agent 处理 core 侧；本关继续：清理收尾，教程 previewer 如实标注 sampled。
directive_events.reason: Core array previews still decimate to 256 px despite #1886; owner routes the core fix to the ADR-054 agent and keeps this session on the tutorial

directive_events.owner_directive: look-at-them 让读者点 mask 的那个 Load，好看到 mask。下一步让读者用 Pair Editor 配对：把 CSV Load 的文件顺序和图像 Load 调换，逼读者手动配对。
directive_events.reason: Owner directed the next two beats: open the mask Load, then pair the two modalities by hand in the Pair Editor

directive_events.owner_directive: 配对这一步顺便把完整 workflow 做出来：normalize 和后续分析。
directive_events.reason: Owner asked for the full analysis workflow at the pairing beat: Pair Editor, Label Spots (region read off the mask), Normalize, Compare Regions

directive_events.owner_directive: pair-them 沿用之前教程的做法：给用户一个 write workflow for me 的按钮，点了再写入完整 workflow。文案太啰嗦，直接说 Let me write the rest of the analysis for you。
directive_events.reason: Owner live-tested: the analysis workflow landed with no reader action; it should arrive on a trigger press, with terser copy

directive_events.owner_directive: Label Spots 改叫 Annotate Regions。
directive_events.reason: Owner renamed the block that reads each spot's region off the mask

directive_events.owner_directive: H&E 选 A：分析 workflow 去掉 Load Slides。图都给一个按钮帮用户写。笔记也帮用户写，笔记里带上图的链接，让图出现在笔记里。
directive_events.reason: Owner settled the post-pairing beats: plots and the conclusion note are trigger-written, the note embeds the figures

directive_events.owner_directive: 笔记先用 A：只写一个结论，不做 markdown 预览，也不让用户保存图。
directive_events.reason: Owner chose a text-only conclusion note written by a trigger; no figure embedding

directive_events.owner_directive: Draw the plots：用户点完 draw 以后再切到 plot 页，否则 UI 刷新不出新的 plot。pair-them 没 run 就跳走了（验证有问题）。
directive_events.reason: Owner live-tested: an open Plots tab misses trigger-written cards; pair-them passed on a stale interaction marker from an earlier run in the same backend process

directive_events.owner_directive: 写 note 那里要引导用户去 New → New note，让用户改 note 的名字，等新的 note 在 canvas 打开以后，再直接一步写。写 note 的办法参考 tutorial 1。
directive_events.reason: Owner wants the reader to create and name the note themselves, with the tutorial filling it once it is open

directive_events.owner_directive: 引入 git branching：告诉用户来了两个新数据，需要稍微不一样的处理方法；让用户开新 git branch，帮用户改 workflow 跑，重复 plot 和写 note；告诉用户切 branch 就能在两批数据的 workflow 间切换，让用户切回第一个 branch，告诉用户第一批的 workflow 回来了，然后结束。
directive_events.reason: Owner specified the closing git-branch segment of level 4

directive_events.owner_directive: 切换分支之前指导用户先提交一下。
directive_events.reason: Owner: commit before branching so the new branch starts from the reader's current work

directive_events.owner_directive: 教程自己的 block 各自给一个图标。git_committed 事件（提交成功时上报，教程可判定已提交）和这个 PR 一起做，在 scope 范围。交互记录不分项目、新建分支不带未提交改动这两个 core 问题不做。
directive_events.reason: Owner widened this PR to a git_committed tutorial event and per-block icons; declined the other two core fixes

directive_events.owner_directive: look-at-them 不只要点 block，还要在 preview 里点一个卡片把数据打开。two-new-tumors 太抽象：让用户点 mask 看，告诉用户直接对比 non-tumor 会引入早期癌变区域等带来的 bias，所以这次只对比癌和 stroma。
directive_events.reason: Owner live-tested: the mask look needs an opened preview card, and the TNBC rationale must be shown on a mask rather than stated

directive_events.owner_directive: Commit 那句需要切到 git tab，focus 到 commit 按钮。
directive_events.reason: Owner: the commit instruction must ring the Git tab's Commit button; needs a git_commit_button highlight target alongside git_committed

directive_events.owner_directive: Commit 的 short message 帮用户填好。make-a-branch 要引导 + 高亮（分支选择器），跟之前一样。
directive_events.reason: Tutorial git guidance: git_commit_button and git_branch_picker highlight targets, a git_commit message prefill, their registries, tests and the spec's prefill list

directive_events.owner_directive: run-tnbc 之前引导用户点 Compare Regions，然后高亮 config 里面的 stroma，告诉用户你改了这个。commit 之后、换 branch 之前也做一个引导，告诉用户原来是啥。
directive_events.reason: Owner wants the recipe difference shown on the Compare Regions setting on both sides of the branch

directive_events.owner_directive: 没给用户说清楚 ER 和 TNBC 是什么。在读数据之前最开始加两句话：今天分析什么数据，ER 和 TNBC 都是什么。
directive_events.reason: Owner reviewed the full level: the subtypes the story turns on were never defined for the reader

directive_events.owner_directive: 图片解码选 A：slides 改 PNG，loader 手写 PNG 解码，不用 Pillow（core 源码不许导入图像解码库，照关卡 2 手写 TIFF 的先例）。
directive_events.reason: Gate pre-PR failed test_core_source_does_not_import_package_owned_image_decoders on the level's Pillow import; owner chose a hand-written PNG reader over exempting tutorial assets
